# CLI: GlobalLoadBalancer

## create-listener

Kind: Write.

Each child write requires an eligible region and package in the caller's catalogs; only hcm-3 is live-verified. Requires --yes. Step two of a Layer 4 setup, after `create-pool`: add one TCP listener bound to the load balancer's only pool, which must be ACTIVE and have no listener; member health (ONLINE, OFFLINE, HEALTHY or UNHEALTHY) is reported, not required. `--allowed-cidrs` is repeatable and required. Each value is a canonical IPv4 network from /8 through /32 with no host bits, with no repeats and no set covering all IPv4 addresses; prefer a /32 for a known client. The set is confirmed by exact read-back, but that does not prove the provider enforces it. No quote is available, and the request carries no price or payment field. GreenNode bills child usage under the account's terms; the SDK neither selects nor verifies the payment source. Deleting does not promise a refund. The create is sent once and never resent. On NotSettled or WriteFailed the partial output on stdout holds only IDs; inspect inventory and billing before another mutation.

| Flag | Type | Required |
|-|-|-|
| `--load-balancer-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--name` | `string` | yes |
| `--pool-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--port` | `int` | yes |
| `--allowed-cidrs` | `[]string` | yes |
| `--project-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--backend-server-id` | `string` | yes |

```sh
vngcloud globalloadbalancer create-listener --load-balancer-id <glb-id> --name <name> --pool-id <pool-id> --port <port> --allowed-cidrs <cidr> --backend-server-id <server-id> --project-id <project-id> --yes
```

## create-load-balancer

Kind: Write.

Requires --yes. Automated payment holds credits for a prepaid three-day forecast; a recorded GNLB_4000 create held 176,000 VND (billing get-balances CashHolding), and deleting the load balancer did not release the hold within minutes; later connection and traffic charges apply. Delete does not promise a refund. On NotSettled inspect inventory and billing before another mutation.

| Flag | Type | Required |
|-|-|-|
| `--name` | `string` | yes |
| `--package-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--description` | `string` |  |

```sh
vngcloud globalloadbalancer create-load-balancer --name <name> --package-id <package-id> --yes
```

## create-pool

Kind: Write.

Each child write requires an eligible region and package in the caller's catalogs; only hcm-3 is live-verified. Requires --yes. Step one of a Layer 4 setup: create the pool first, then `create-listener`. Adds one TCP pool with one private member group holding one vServer backend, on an existing Layer 4 load balancer that has no pool and no listener. The backend address is the server's private fixed IP, proven from the server, VPC and subnet under `--project-id`, which must be the project of this client; a floating IP is never used and no raw address is accepted. No quote is available, and the request carries no price or payment field. GreenNode bills child usage under the account's terms; the SDK neither selects nor verifies the payment source. Deleting does not promise a refund. The create is sent once and never resent. Success needs exact read-back of one pool and its group, never traffic. The pool and its health monitor must be ACTIVE; member health is reported, not required, so a new backend shows OFFLINE until health checks pass, and UNHEALTHY if they cannot reach it. On NotSettled or WriteFailed the partial output on stdout holds only IDs; inspect inventory and billing before another mutation.

| Flag | Type | Required |
|-|-|-|
| `--load-balancer-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--name` | `string` | yes |
| `--member-name` | `string` | yes |
| `--project-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--backend-server-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--backend-vpc-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--backend-subnet-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--backend-port` | `int` | yes |

```sh
vngcloud globalloadbalancer create-pool --load-balancer-id <glb-id> --name <name> --member-name <member-name> --backend-server-id <server-id> --backend-vpc-id <vpc-id> --backend-subnet-id <subnet-id> --backend-port <port> --project-id <project-id> --yes
```

## delete-listener

Kind: Write, destructive.

Each child write requires an eligible region and package in the caller's catalogs; only hcm-3 is live-verified. Requires --yes. Step one of cleanup, then `delete-pool`, and `delete-load-balancer`. Deletes the sole listener of a Layer 4 load balancer after re-reading it and its pool; the pool and its member group stay, and the listener stops receiving traffic. `Deleted` is true only after the complete listener list omits the ID while its pool and the load balancer remain; a 404 or an `internal_error` on the exact read is consistent with that, and any other result keeps waiting. Deleting does not promise a refund. On NotSettled the partial output holds the IDs; inspect inventory and billing before another mutation.

| Flag | Type | Required |
|-|-|-|
| `--load-balancer-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--listener-id` | `string` | yes |

```sh
vngcloud globalloadbalancer delete-listener --load-balancer-id <glb-id> --listener-id <listener-id> --yes
```

## delete-pool

Kind: Write, destructive.

Each child write requires an eligible region and package in the caller's catalogs; only hcm-3 is live-verified. Requires --yes. Step two of cleanup, after `delete-listener` and before `delete-load-balancer`. Deletes the pool together with its one private member group and backend row, never the vServer. Refuses, sending nothing, unless the pool is the load balancer's only pool, is ACTIVE with an ACTIVE health monitor, has no listener, and holds exactly one expected private group; member health (ONLINE, OFFLINE, HEALTHY or UNHEALTHY) is reported, not required. Delete the pool before its backend server: the command refuses while the API reports the backend row as not settled, such as CREATING. The API refuses to delete the last group on its own, so there is no command for it. `Deleted` is true only after the complete pool list omits the ID while the load balancer remains; a 404 or an `internal_error` on the exact read is consistent with that, and any other result keeps waiting. Deleting does not promise a refund. On NotSettled the partial output holds the IDs; inspect inventory and billing before another mutation.

| Flag | Type | Required |
|-|-|-|
| `--load-balancer-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--pool-id` | `string` | yes |

```sh
vngcloud globalloadbalancer delete-pool --load-balancer-id <glb-id> --pool-id <pool-id> --yes
```
